Message:
The fight was over
in the blink of an eye.

“I knew you could do it, Florence.
But, to think that you can
take them down all on your own.”

“No, I couldn’t have
done it on my own.
I won this fight because
you were with me, Fortina.”

Aah...! There you are.
That’s the Florence I know.
Thank goodness...!

Suddenly,
the setting sun lit the sky,
enveloping us in the warmth of
its orange glow.

Back then,
you were the one who
made that vow to me.
So, this time...

“Listen, Florence.
This time, let me be
the one who vows to you.

Even if the day comes
when we must part ways,
I will never stop believing in you.”

From this day forth,
I will walk beside you.

For I want us to gaze upon
the same things,
carry the same regrets...
and support each other
for the rest of our lives.

“So please, always keep
my heart close to yours.”

When you feel like your heart is
on the verge of being crushed,
I’ll be there to keep it safe.

Just as you have
always protected mine.

So, I make this vow before God...
No, I make this vow to you.
